div.div:
Database access
PgDog serves product-db to product, inventory, cart, checkout, order, payment and both workers; the PgBouncer Pooler serves platform-db to user, review, shipping, notification. Every pooled hop is TLS verify-full against homelab-ca; Keycloak and Temporal connect to platform-db-rw directly. analytics has no PostgreSQL: it reads ClickHouse serving views over plaintext native :9000. PeerDB fills them from product-db by CDC, through its own PgBouncer pooler (not drawn: a node took the crossings from 9 to 24; see databases/cdc). All ten runtime passwords are OpenBao static roles that OpenBao rotates and ESO syncs into each namespace's Secret. Detail: databases/topology.
